scope: Project numerical screening for the paired extent study. These tolerances are not COST or AIJ standards and do not establish empirical accuracy.

heat.definition: abs(net_outward_all_patches_W) / prescribed_roof_input_W; CSV column4 already includes the roof term.

probes.purpose: A stable 200-iteration tail at the same 12 street probes. Mean drift limits match the provisional reporting steps. Peak-to-peak limits screen ongoing oscillation. This is a numerical stability check, not a comfort or prediction-accuracy threshold.

publication: Both paired cases must pass at their exported iterations. The geometry and side-boundary comparisons must then be assessed on common valid core points. Retain pending inlet, mesh and empirical validation labels.
